name: scalemate-landing
postCreateCommand: npm install && npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code && pip install -r seo-system/skills/seo-ops/requirements.txt && bash .devcontainer/setup-gsc.sh && bash seo-system/scripts/codespace-autorun.sh

GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID.description: Google OAuth Client ID for GSC API

GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Google OAuth Client Secret for GSC API

GSC_TOKEN_JSON.description: Pre-authenticated GSC token (paste contents of .gsc-token.json from local machine, base64-encoded)

AHREFS_MCP_KEY.description: Ahrefs hosted MCP API key from claude.ai connector (for .claude/mcp.json)

CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN.description: Long-lived OAuth token for Claude Code CLI
